title: Star Wars Essentials
description: Characters, planets, films — the basics that come up at trivia.

questions.prompt: What is Luke Skywalker's home planet?
What year was the original Star Wars film released?
questions.explanation: Star Wars (later retitled A New Hope) premiered May 25, 1977 and became a cultural phenomenon that reshaped the modern blockbuster.

questions.prompt: What color is Mace Windu's lightsaber?
questions.explanation: Samuel L. Jackson asked George Lucas for a unique color so he could spot himself in battle scenes; Mace's purple blade debuted in Attack of the Clones.

questions.prompt: Who is Luke Skywalker's twin sister?
questions.explanation: The twins were separated at birth to hide them from Vader; Leia was adopted by Bail Organa of Alderaan, Luke by the Lars family on Tatooine.

questions.prompt: What is the name of Han Solo's ship?
questions.explanation: The Falcon is a modified YT-1300 Corellian freighter Han won from Lando Calrissian in a game of sabacc.

questions.prompt: What species is Chewbacca?
Who trained Luke Skywalker on Dagobah?
questions.explanation: Yoda hid on the swamp planet Dagobah after Order 66; he trains Luke there in The Empire Strikes Back (1980).

questions.prompt: What is Darth Vader's birth name?
questions.explanation: Anakin was the prophesied Chosen One, falling to the dark side in Revenge of the Sith (2005) before being entombed in the Vader suit.

questions.prompt: Who shot first?
questions.explanation: In the 1977 original, Han shoots Greedo in the Mos Eisley cantina; Lucas's 1997 Special Edition controversially altered the scene to have Greedo shoot first.

questions.prompt: What is the name of the bounty hunter who captures Han Solo in The Empire Strikes Back?
questions.explanation: Boba delivers a carbonite-frozen Han to Jabba the Hutt; the helmeted bounty hunter became a fan icon despite minimal screen time.

questions.prompt: What planet is the Rebel base on at the start of The Empire Strikes Back?
questions.explanation: Hoth is the icy world where Echo Base hides until Imperial probe droids spot it, triggering the Battle of Hoth with AT-AT walkers.

questions.prompt: What is the name of the Sith Lord apprentice with a double-bladed lightsaber in The Phantom Menace?
questions.explanation: The horned Dathomirian Zabrak served Darth Sidious and killed Qui-Gon Jinn on Naboo before being sliced in half by Obi-Wan in 1999's The Phantom Menace.

questions.prompt: Who is the main character of The Mandalorian?
questions.explanation: Played by Pedro Pascal, Din is a bounty hunter who becomes guardian to Grogu in the Disney+ series that premiered in 2019.

questions.prompt: What is the in-universe name of the character commonly called Baby Yoda?
questions.explanation: His name was kept secret until episode 4 of The Mandalorian season 2; he's a Force-sensitive member of Yoda's mysterious species.

questions.prompt: What is the name of the desert scavenger heroine introduced in The Force Awakens?
questions.explanation: Played by Daisy Ridley, Rey is introduced scavenging Star Destroyer wrecks on Jakku in 2015's The Force Awakens.

questions.prompt: What is Kylo Ren's birth name?
questions.explanation: Son of Han Solo and Leia Organa, Ben was named for Ben Kenobi and trained by Luke before being turned by Snoke.

questions.prompt: What is the forest moon where the Ewoks live?
questions.explanation: Technically the Forest Moon of Endor; the second Death Star's shield generator is hidden there in Return of the Jedi (1983).

questions.prompt: Who directed the original 1977 Star Wars film?
Han Solo brags that the Millennium Falcon made the Kessel Run in less than how many parsecs?
questions.explanation: A parsec is a unit of distance, not time — fans debated the line for decades until Solo (2018) showed Han taking a shortcut through the Maelstrom.

questions.prompt: Who is the protagonist of Rogue One?
questions.explanation: Played by Felicity Jones, Jyn leads the squad that steals the Death Star plans in Rogue One: A Star Wars Story (2016).

questions.prompt: What is the protocol droid C-3PO's primary function?
questions.explanation: C-3PO is fluent in over six million forms of communication and was built by a young Anakin Skywalker on Tatooine.

questions.prompt: What is the name of Obi-Wan Kenobi's Padawan who later becomes Darth Vader?
questions.explanation: Obi-Wan promised the dying Qui-Gon he would train Anakin; their final duel on Mustafar leaves Anakin maimed and reborn as Vader.

questions.prompt: What is the capital planet of the Republic and later the Empire, home to the Jedi Temple?
questions.explanation: Coruscant is an ecumenopolis — a city-planet whose entire surface is urbanized — featured heavily in the prequel trilogy.

questions.prompt: Complete the line: 'I am your ___.'
questions.explanation: Vader's reveal in The Empire Strikes Back is often misquoted as 'Luke, I am your father'; the actual line is 'No, I am your father.'

questions.prompt: What is the name of Anakin Skywalker's Padawan in The Clone Wars?
questions.explanation: The Togruta apprentice debuted in the 2008 animated film and series; she later got her own live-action Disney+ show, played by Rosario Dawson.
